 # Architecture
+
+## Textured-tip source preparation — internal work in progress
+
+`core/brush-texture.ts` and `engine/brush-texture.ts` define internal image-backed coverage preparation. `BrushTextureSampler` reads an existing `AssetStore` bitmap into a requested output tile or native source crop; original Blob bytes and decoded dimensions remain asset-owned. Working tiles use the existing 4,000,000-pixel/4096-dimension allocation policy, independently of source image geometry. Larger output requests must be split by the caller, never implemented by resizing/rejecting the original. Fractional source rectangles must remain representable and inside the original image. Smoothing is explicit, default true; false requests native nearest-neighbor sampling.
+
+The ordinary pixel worker executes actual `brushTextureMask` WASM. Alpha mode uses source alpha; inversion uses `255-alpha`. Luminance mode uses encoded RGB weights `(2126R+7152G+722B)/10000`, with black as ink by default; inverted luminance uses white as ink. Both luminance modes multiply by source alpha, so transparent input remains transparent. Coverage rounds half up to an 8-bit alpha and returns white RGB. Canvas canonicalizes fully transparent pixels to transparent black. This is encoded-channel coverage, not linear-light or ICC-managed luminance. Conversion happens after native image sampling.
+
+The sampler retains at most 32 MiB of private working surfaces by default, using the existing byte/entry-bounded Canvas cache. Keys include bitmap identity, channel/inversion, exact source crop, output grid and smoothing. Returned canvases are caller-owned copies, never cache-owned buffers; the caller must release them. Reset/disposal invalidates pending publication, and cancellation/source ownership/lifetime checks reject stale results. Worker inputs/settings are copied before readiness and returned type/extent are validated. Cache-copy allocation failure releases its private surface and preserves successfully prepared caller output. The sampler borrows the pixel processor and does not dispose it or the source assets.
+
+This preparation service is **not yet connected to authored strokes, stamp geometry, GPU/SVG replay, tools or portable brush presets**. No public `BrushTexture` constructor, schema change, script/plugin privilege, REST operation or completed F06 feature is claimed. The dated roadmap records verification and the remaining integration work.
 
 `core/text-style.ts` applies the complete native font/spacing/direction state for text measurement, Canvas glyph drawing and SVG baseline preparation. It resets absent tracking/word spacing/kerning/direction and rejects unsupported nondefault word spacing/kerning before drawing. It retains native whole-line shaping instead of splitting glyphs or words. TextLayer setters, `resetSpacing` and strict layer.update share ordinary locks/history; typography patches require text layers. Immutable content signatures already include new primitive typography fields, invalidating reference/GPU glyph caches. Resize gestures capture complete typography and measure the new font size without overriding it with the captured size. Approximate headless bounds do not claim font parity. Schema 25 validates optional wordSpacing/fontKerning and gates them outside any immutable drawing proof; legacy roots/history migrate without inserted defaults. See the TextLayer guide for defaults, limits, feature detection and exact export behavior.
